2:64928|0|0|1|l|0|3322|1|Slide 1: “At the core of our mission is a commitment to creating pieces that will stir your soul and invite you inward.” - Founder, Donnie Soddu  Slide 2: Dear reader, High Light began as a personal pursuit, a creative outlet, an escape. As a mother and person of color with a deep respect for nature, I felt a strong pull to create something hopeful and environmentally responsible. Slide 3: I decided to channel my experience in the fashion, wellness and beauty industries to create a company that combines timeless design with a sense of intentionality and care for our shared future. Slide 4: To me, High Light is about the practice. The shift in mindset toward the deeper appreciation and compassion that our future requires. Slide 5: The pieces we create are simply manifestations of that mindset, made to help support that shift. I hope they bring you pleasure and peace. — Donnie

2:64936|0|0|1|l|0|3422|1|Request:  The Ritualist blog post break down  Intention: Promote the blog and themes  To be posted: October 17Story set needed: Yes - Story and feed Copy:  Slide 1: Five Ways to Connect with Spirit Through Rituals of Adornment  Slide 2:  Perhaps you are already working with jewelry ritually subconsciously, or maybe you are already ritually minded, casting spells with your sacred and favorite pieces. Here are five ways to connect with spirit through rituals of adornment.Slide 3: 1. Wearing Jewelry to Set an Intention  Call on rituals of adornment to help set intentions. To do this, first, cleanse the piece using sacred smoke, salt, or crystals. Then, hold the jewelry in both your hands. Speak your intention over the jewelry three times. Slide 4: 2. Adornment as a Protection Spell Speak a spell of protection over your rings, earrings, necklaces, and bracelets, and feel them absorb any negative energy that comes your way. Use healing smoke to cleanse your pieces, place them in a dish of salt, or allow them to sit in the light of the moon to help clear any energy from your day-to-day. Slide 5: 3. Rituals of Adornment to Ground and Center  Adorning yourself with jewelry intentionally imbued with the healing power of crystals can balance, support and transform your energetic body. When you feel your energy become low, chaotic or detached, simply pause, touch the necklace you’re intentionally wearing, and take a deep breath.  Slide 6: 4. Connecting with the Moon’s Magic through Jewelry  Place your jewelry on a windowsill or inside a bit of silk outside to absorb the glow and energy of the moon. You might feel called to do this on a new moon phase if you wish to enchant your jewelry with the energy of new beginnings or intention setting, or on a full moon if you wish to charge your jewelry with the powers of release, wholeness, or celebration.  Slide 7: 5. Wearing Jewelry as Ancestral Veneration  By wearing jewelry handed down through your family, you honor those who came before you, working with your body as an altar. If you don’t have a relationship with your ancestors, or heirlooms to wear,  you can purchase auspicious pieces of jewelry in the name and honor of a specific family member, or acquire jewelry that is special to you to pass down to the next generation, as you will one day be a benevolent ancestor.
